comments.body_html:
I have created a new repository for my script and added new features. If you would like to implement them in your script, the new repo is https://github.com/jbs4bmx/StartSPT

Added support for creation of a START Menu shortcut.

Updated some minor bits of code.

Added experimental support for Intel CPUs with P/E Cores when calculating for affinity.

Enjoy!
